name: CarPlay Ultra-Lite
description: CarPlay Ultra features on a Gen5W head unit's own screen, for wireless CarPlay with iOS 26 or later: the car's climate in CarPlay both ways (dock temperatures, Apple's Climate app, a panel per seat with power buttons, Driver Only, seat heat, front and rear defrost), the car's page in CarPlay's Vehicle app (battery, range, odometer, switches for the ambient light effect and for battery preconditioning through Launchpad, buttons that open the head unit's own screens), and with the E-GMP CarPlay EV Routing mod's theme on, the CarPlay Ultra theme with its wallpapers and Themes page. DiPO's CarPlay receiver is patched in memory (libCarPlayCore.so, one recipe); the vehicle state streams use ports 7130-7135 on the hotspot. Built and tested on the Ioniq 6 (CEEV USA 260507); run the compatibility check (cp-climate-check) before installing on another car. Based on LIVI by Lasse Heitgres (GPL-3.0).
